Only formal rounds and closings supply assessment evidence. No audience answer rescues or undermines a move and no failure-to-reply penalty follows merely from White’s last closing. Zero burden adjustments identify capture in the move judgments rather than duplicate consequences.

Logical scope, evidential support, responsiveness, burden relevance, clarity and qualification receive distinct reasons. No rating is based on transcript recognition uncertainty; the familiar wording of rubric criteria is supported by source-specific conduct.

Pass A’s brief phrase about dismissal of meaningful variants is read with its adjacent explicit local-significance and whole-message distinction; it does not assert that White denies their acknowledged importance.
